in_sanskrit.name: Anamay
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Without Illness
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Anamay एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Anamay is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘anam’ meaning ‘without’ and ‘may’ meaning ‘illness’. This name signifies being free from disease and suffering.
